entries.reviewNotes: Read Japanese municipal-notice interpreter request and all12 full dialogue/hints. Verified Vietnamese preference despite basic Japanese responses, actual notice plus envelope, separate appointment/interpreter availability, Monday afternoon after support confirmed, noon-to-one callback and reconfirm both support and time. Corrected Tagalog difficulty construction.

Read Japanese post-consultation document request and all12 full dialogue/hints. Verified receipt/payment record versus doctor diagnostic certificate, employer content determines need, designated call place rather than corridor, employer accepts visit-date receipt, no certificate application, receipt date check/original retention. No correction needed.

Read Japanese lost-wallet journey report and all12 full dialogue/hints. Verified loss noticed after bus when buying drink, last pharmacy payment1410 then station bus to Higashi Danchi, brown long wallet white clasp scuff and one bank card, contact bank/bus, mobile notification before collection. Clarified Burmese noticed-location question.

Read Japanese missed-delivery storage-location confusion and all12 full dialogue/hints. Verified parcel not at nearby counter, call printed contact with parcel number/deadline, evening collection confirmed by phone with notice/ID, similar-name risk and cross-check correct address/hours. No correction needed.

Read Japanese lost-bank-card stop and replacement case and all12 full dialogue/hints. Verified missing card only on home arrival, passbook/residence card identification and PIN not spoken, prioritize stop, check replacement fee/interim cash, found card requires bank contact before use. Repaired Tagalog missing addressee in replacement question.

Read Japanese unopened dried-noodle package-hole case and all12 full dialogue/hints. Verified purchase yesterday, uneaten/unopened, kitchen shelf and unknown damage timing, receipt and exchange assessment before case-specific approval, inspect new bag, surrender old and keep exchange slip, recheck before cooking. No correction required.
